text: Planning a trip is exciting, but it also takes time and effort. First, you choose a destination and book tickets and hotels. When you arrive, everything feels new: the culture, the music, and the way people live. Trying local food is one of the best parts of travelling, even if you are not sure what you are eating! Sometimes there are language barriers, and you have to use gestures or simple words to communicate. These moments can be funny and teach you a lot. In the end, you return home with wonderful memories that stay with you forever.
